sloka: भिषणो अयम् महाकायो राक्षसो भुज विक्रमः ।लोकम् हि अति जितम् कृत्वा हि अवाम् हन्तुम् इह इच्छति ॥३-७०-५॥
transliteration: bhiṣaṇo ayam mahākāyo rākṣaso bhuja vikramaḥ ।lokam hi ati jitam kṛtvā hi avām hantum iha icchati ॥3-70-5॥

translations.english: This huge, horrible demon with the strength of his arms has conquered the world, and now intends to kill us here.
